mapper.select: SELECT id, access_request_id, attachment_type, file_name, file_path, file_size, mime_type, uploaded_by, uploaded_at, deleted FROM tb_access_attachment WHERE access_request_id = #{accessRequestId} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY uploaded_at DESC
SELECT id, access_request_id, attachment_type, file_name, file_path, file_size, mime_type, uploaded_by, uploaded_at, deleted FROM tb_access_attachment WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_access_attachment ( access_request_id, attachment_type, file_name, file_path, file_size, mime_type, uploaded_by, uploaded_at, deleted ) VALUES ( #{accessRequestId}, #{attachmentType}, #{fileName}, #{filePath}, #{fileSize}, #{mimeType}, #{uploadedBy}, SYSUTCDATETIME(), 0 )
